title: Fonderie directs. The AI executes.
lede: From idea to shipped product in three steps. Fonderie is the director. Your AI is the builder.

steps.title: You describe your product
steps.text: "I need a SaaS with login, Stripe billing, and team workspaces."

steps.title: Any AI follows the same playbook
steps.text: Fonderie's playbook lives in your repo. Your AI reads it before building — so your product comes out the same way every time, no matter which AI you use.

steps.title: You review and ship
steps.text: The AI generates the code. Fonderie's types and tests verify it. You customize the design and deploy. Your backend is secure, your frontend works, and your customers can sign up and pay.
